mentions.name: vpdf
mentions.description: A vim-inspired terminal PDF reader built with MuPDF and the Kitty Graphics Protocol, letting users read PDFs in the terminal using vim keybindings.
mentions.problem: The author wanted to use vim bindings for reading PDFs, so built the reader mostly for personal use.
